question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 30%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Responses and Additional Evidence of Capability - 5%; 4. Competitiveness and Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
acceptance: All four categories and 30/40/5/25%; allow synonymous category descriptions.
